question: Which drug kills the most people in the world?
answer: Alcohol kills more people worldwide than heroin or cocaine, about 2.6 million deaths a year. That is roughly 1 death in every 20 on Earth. It tops the list because so many people drink it, it is legal and accepted, and its health harm is massive.
move: The deadliest drug is the legal one almost everyone drinks.
